newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka's J.R. Jayewardene dies at 90.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka's J.R. Jayewardene dies at 90.

text.p: Former Sri Lankan president Junius Richard Jayewardene died on Friday at the age of 90, his United National Party said.
Jayewardene ruled the Indian Ocean island for 11 years from 1977 to 1988 as prime minister and as its first executive president.
"He passed away," the United National Party's general secretary Gamini Athukorala told Reuters without elaborating.
Jayewardene died at a private hospital in Colombo after a two-week stay for treatment of cancer, a hospital official said.

Jayawardene's reputation as a strongman and one of South Asia's shrewdest leaders suffered after his mid 1980s efforts to settle Sri Lanka's ethnic conflict failed and Tamil rebels intensified their war which still plagues the country.
After his retirement in 1989 from 50 years of political life, Jayewardene became a whipping boy for the island's economic and political ills.
